name: Service Wise Sales
query:
SELECT 
    b.`posting_date` AS "Date",
    CASE
        WHEN b.`order_type` = "Aggregators" THEN b.`customer`
        ELSE b.`order_type`
    END AS "Order Type",
    SUM(b.`grand_total`) AS "Grand Total"
FROM 
    (
        SELECT %(start_date)s AS `date`
        UNION
        SELECT DATE_ADD(%(start_date)s, INTERVAL n DAY) AS `date`
        FROM (
            SELECT a.N + b.N * 10 + c.N * 100 + 1 AS n
            FROM (
                SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 
                UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
            ) a
            CROSS JOIN (
                SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 
                UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
            ) b
            CROSS JOIN (
                SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 
                UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
            ) c
        ) nums
        WHERE DATE_ADD(%(start_date)s, INTERVAL n DAY) < %(end_date)s
        UNION
        SELECT %(end_date)s AS `date`
    ) date_list
LEFT JOIN `tabPOS Invoice` b ON (
    b.`branch` = %(branch)s
    AND b.`status` IN ("Consolidated","Paid") 
    AND b.`docstatus` = 1
)
LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
WHERE
    (
        ((rs.`hours` IS NULL OR rs.`hours` = 0) AND b.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
        OR (
            rs.`hours` > 0 
            AND TIMESTAMP(b.`posting_date`, b.`posting_time`)
                BETWEEN TIMESTAMP(date_list.`date`, CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00'))
                AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(date_list.`date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00'))
        )
        OR (rs.`branch` IS NULL AND b.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
    )
GROUP BY 
    date_list.`date`,
    CASE
        WHEN b.`order_type` = "Aggregators" THEN b.`customer`
        ELSE b.`order_type`
    END
ORDER BY 
    date_list.`date` ASC,
    CASE
        WHEN b.`order_type` = "Aggregators" THEN b.`customer`
        ELSE b.`order_type`
    END ASC;
